assistant.instructions: A Risk (XRisk) is scored on the likelihood and impact matrix, before and after its controls (its Risk Control lines). A Control (XControl) is Planned, In Place or Retired; its Control Test lines, each with its evidence, show whether it works. A Risk Acceptance (XRiskAcceptance: Draft, Accepted, Rejected, Revoked, Expired) records who accepted a risk and until when. A Policy (XPolicy) is Published by revision, and a Policy Acknowledgement (XPolicyAcknowledgement) records who read which revision. A Finding (XFinding: Open, Remediating, Closed) is a gap found.

solutions.source: {"decisions":[],"id":"grc.rules","kind":"Solution","label":"Governance and Risk rules","parameters":{"tolerance":{"type":"int","value":6}},"processes":[],"requires":[],"rules":[{"aggregates":[{"entity":"XRiskAcceptance","filter":[["status","=","Accepted"],["expires_on",">=",{"today":0}]],"link":"risk","name":"held","op":"exists"}],"check":"doc.treatment != \"Accept\" || doc.current_likelihood * doc.current_impact <= parameters.tolerance || aggregates.held","entity":"XRisk","field":"treatment","id":"accepted_only_with_acceptance","message":"a risk above the tolerance is accepted only with an approved acceptance","phase":"validate"},{"aggregates":[{"entity":"XRiskAcceptance","filter":[["status","=","Accepted"],["expires_on",">=",{"today":0}]],"link":"risk","name":"held","op":"exists"}],"entity":"XRisk","id":"open_again","phase":"derive","when":"has(doc.recheck) && doc.recheck","writes":{"recheck":"false","treatment":"doc.treatment == \"Accept\" && !aggregates.held ? \"Open\" : doc.treatment"}}],"schema_version":"ferrum.solution/1","tests":[],"ui":{"layout":{}},"version":"1.0.0"}
